name: Makino Shougo
source:
A senior seminar student with a seemingly sincere attitude.
When he was in college, he pursued his junior Madoka, but...
In the present, he appears in front of the protagonist, but his intentions are unknown.

A handsome senior from the same seminar.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1161863]Getchu[/url]]
